egg_interaction_v1.description: One held-spatula interaction policy, EE-local geometric proposals; jointly learned two-view perception, no semantic-pose oracle or learned pickup.
egg_interaction_v1.architecture_rationale: Keep the original three-mode GRU prior but replace unavailable blade/PnP labels with measured EE local displacement. Small shared spatial CNNs learn observation features end-to-end. Five observations preserve short support/motion history; a persistent initial scene reference defines the task. Three modes avoid averaging insertion and withdrawal. Diffusion is unnecessary for one 100ms six-vector with only 20 episodes and unlabelled outcomes.

data_plan.rationale: Retain all original episodes as context/target/evidence; deduplicate the 20 overlapping executor prefixes rather than count them as additional examples. Keep supplied control intervals unchanged in ORIGINAL_CUT.json. Sample every third row plus last eligible anchor, achieving about 10Hz distinct targets while preserving long corrections and release sequences. No success filtering or phase recutting. All sampling uses source indices. Initial third-view row0 is causal goal context. Whole-episode train/validation/test split remains 11/4/5 unless strict cross-episode near-duplicate audit groups episodes. Media are cached once per required source frame; no synthetic terminal state.
data_plan.changes_from_prior: The original plan is preserved verbatim in preparation original_source_plan.json and the journal; ORIGINAL_CUT.json preserves all bounds. Unavailable tool landmark measurements, pan surface height and mask annotations prevent defensible blade/PnP supervision. Adapt only the representation: achieved six-coordinate EE local motion using T_base_ee at i and i+3, not fabricated blade motion. Remove scene_geometry_aux semantic output dependency; all necessary learned perception is the shared CNN trained jointly from motion loss, with no privileged geometry inputs. Metric collision/acquisition geometry remains a required executor integration, not an invented learned capability. Fixed workspace/full wrist crops and initial scene replace object-centred mask crops; no arbitrary-object transfer claim. Five-step finite-history GRU replaces 2s TBPTT and persistent hidden state to match online reset exactly. Omit q/dq (planner handles kinematics), retain EE pose, external joint torques, width, age/validity and actual history timing. Use mixture NLL plus responsibility-weighted endpoint Huber; no unsupported blade-axis regularizer. Train static windows at <=10 percent, episode balanced; block-disjoint held-out evaluation and motion-stratified diagnostics, not learned success. No novel cut experiment.

segments.rationale: Control [1000,2900); camera timestamp reset not repaired.
Control [400,1831); release 1550-1610 kept, no phase input.

dependencies: Training uses only locked torch/numpy/scipy/OpenCV and original RGB/state; no external weights or licences. Physical execution requires an independently validated grasp/retention procedure, installed force-limited Cartesian contact tracker, collision/tool geometry, calibrated flange-to-EE, workspace interlock, image freshness monitoring and Agent outcome inspection. These are unverified deployment gates, not training blockers for achieved EE motion imitation.
adaptations: One callable learned policy with jointly trained visual encoder replaces two separately trained components of the source prior. No semantic geometry, grasp or success estimator is claimed. Output ABI is explicitly changed from blade to current recorded EE axes. Full original source plan retained as preparation evidence. Agent supplies initial scene reference and observed supported/safe context; no future target, phase or episode ID is an input. Geometry execution is a proposal adapter, not physical control here.
limitations: Only 20 same-setup demonstrations, no success labels, unknown contact dynamics, possible camera skew and controller lag. End-to-end images sacrifice metric object-frame invariance; fixed camera/tool/grasp envelope required. No foods/material/heat transfer or autonomous failure recovery evidence. Negative image ages are retained with bounded skew tolerance, not timestamp corrected. Offline validation and executable calling tests do not establish safe robot operation or flip success. Geometry acquisition and safety adapters must be commissioned separately.
